Manifest.Name: 养蛇拓展｜Snake Ranch
Manifest.Author: Snake Ranch Contributors
Manifest.Description: 普通眼镜蛇、稀有王蛇与配色繁育玉米蛇：七种基础色、双色和主色纯度，蛇蛋继承配色；肉食正常养玉米蛇，鼠餐只显色。保留真实满餐、消化姿态、蛇杖、交配蛇球、护蛋、液体蛇毒与扩建蛇笼。新增养蛇人开局、蛇夫人清洁补给与可退出对话。完整中英双语，详见README。 / Raise common cobras, King Cobras and pet corn snakes. Breed seven base colours, two-colour coats and colour purity; eggs inherit their colours. Meat supports normal corn-snake growth, while mouse treats improve coloration. Includes digestion poses, snake staffs, mating balls, egg guarding, liquid venom and expandable cages. Adds a Snake Rancher start, Snake Lady cleaning supplies and a dialogue exit. Chinese and English follow the game language; see README.
